heading: INT. SKERRIGAN POINT LIGHTHOUSE - KEEPER'S KITCHEN - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SKERRIGAN POINT LIGHTHOUSE - KEEPER'S KITCHEN - NIGHT
Whitewashed stone.
A coal stove.
A table with five chairs and a dead man's teacup still half full.
The lamp above turns slowly, sweeping the window with light.
INSPECTOR ODILE FARR, 40s, rain-wet coat, stands at the head of the table with a notebook.
BARTHOLOMEW "BART" GRIGG, 60, the assistant keeper, grey beard, wrings his cap.
SISTER AGATHA, 70, a nun in a black habit, folds her hands.
PIPPIN, 10, a boy, sits cross-legged under the table with a toy lighthouse.
Who last saw Keeper Thorne alive?
units.name: ODILE

units.text: Me. Supper, nine o'clock.
units.name: BART

units.text: And I brought him tea at ten.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: I saw him at eleven.
units.name: PIPPIN

units.text: All heads turn.
Pippin looks up, wide-eyed.
Where?
units.name: ODILE

units.text: On the stairs. Going up.
units.name: PIPPIN

units.text: Boy, that's not possible. The door was locked.
units.name: BART

units.text: The telephone on the wall rings.
Everyone freezes.
Odile lifts it.
Farr.
units.name: ODILE

units.text: Inspector, we have the autopsy. Thorne died at nine thirty.
units.name: COMMISSIONER

units.text: Then who went up the stairs at eleven?
units.name: ODILE

units.text: The lamp overhead stops turning.
Light holds on the window, still and white.
